title: Premium Multi-Purpose Pet Carrier for Small to Medium Pets
description:
This carrier is built to be the one bag that works for almost any trip, whether that's a quick dash to the vet, a weekend visit to family, or a longer day out together. It suits small to medium dogs, cats, rabbits and other similarly sized pets, so it's a genuinely useful option if you have more than one type of pet at home or simply want something versatile.

The main compartment is generously padded along the base, which takes the edge off bumpy pavements and car journeys alike, while mesh panels on three sides keep air moving so your pet doesn't feel closed in. A top-loading zip opening sits alongside the usual front entry, which makes a real difference when you're trying to settle a nervous pet in without a struggle.

We've also thought about you, not just your pet. A padded, adjustable shoulder strap and a sturdy top carry handle mean you can switch grips depending on the day, and the whole thing folds flat when it's empty so it doesn't take up much room between trips. The zips are backed with a safety clip, so there's no risk of an unexpected escape mid-journey.

Inside, a removable cushioned liner lifts out for washing, which matters more than it sounds once you've had a long car journey or an accident to deal with. The frame keeps its shape even when packed for a longer trip, so your pet always has a stable, level base to settle onto.

This is a demonstration product listing, added to show how a full product page looks on Pet Carrier. Real products will be added via the admin panel once the store goes live.

title: Sherpa Original Deluxe Airline Approved Pet Carrier for Small Dogs and Cats
description:
## About the Sherpa Original Deluxe Pet Carrier

The Sherpa Original Deluxe is one of the most trusted airline approved pet carriers on the market, chosen by thousands of pet parents worldwide for its clever spring wire frame that lets you compress the carrier to fit under aeroplane seats without compromising your pet's comfort.

Whether you are flying home for the holidays, driving to the vet, or taking your small dog or cat on a weekend trip, this [airline approved carrier](/carriers/airline-approved-carriers) gives your pet a secure and comfortable space to travel.

## Key Features and Benefits

### Airline Approved Design

Meets the in cabin requirements of most major UK, US, and European airlines. The medium size accommodates pets up to 7kg and fits under most standard airline seats. Always check specific measurements with your airline before travel.

### Patented Spring Wire Frame

The standout feature is the patented spring wire frame. The rear panel flexes and compresses by several centimetres when needed for tight aeroplane spaces, then springs back to full shape once you settle into your seat. This means your pet gets full comfort during flight without sacrificing airline compliance.

### Machine Washable Lambskin Liner

The removable faux lambskin liner adds warmth and comfort for your pet. When it gets dirty from travel adventures, simply take it out and machine wash it on a gentle cycle. Air dry before reinserting.

### Multiple Access Points

Top loading and side loading zippered openings make it easy to get anxious pets in and out. Mesh panels on multiple sides provide ventilation and let your pet see you during the journey.

### Safety Features

Includes an adjustable shoulder strap, seat belt safety strap for car travel, and locking zippers to keep escape artists safely contained. The bottom is reinforced to protect your pet from any pressure.

## Who This Carrier Is Best For

This [small dog carrier](/carriers/dog-carriers/small-dog-carriers) and [cat carrier](/carriers/cat-carriers) suits:

- Small dogs under 7kg (Chihuahuas, Yorkies, Toy Poodles, small terriers)
- Cats up to 7kg
- Anxious pets who need to see their owner during travel
- Frequent air travellers who need a proven airline approved option
- Owners who value machine washable, easy to clean carriers
- Pet parents making regular [vet visits](/carriers/vet-visit-carriers)

## Care Instructions

Spot clean the exterior with a damp cloth. Remove and machine wash the liner separately on gentle cycle. Do not tumble dry. Air dry completely before reinserting. Store in a dry place when not in use.

faqs.answer: The medium size meets the standard in cabin pet carrier requirements for most major airlines including British Airways, Virgin Atlantic, Lufthansa, KLM, Air France, and most US carriers. Always verify current requirements with your specific airline before booking.

faqs.answer: The removable liner can be machine washed on gentle cycle. The main carrier structure should be spot cleaned only to preserve the spring wire frame.

faqs.answer: Yes, the spring wire compression feature is specifically designed to fit under standard aeroplane seats even when they are tight. Always measure your specific seat before travel.

faqs.answer: The padded interior, ventilation panels, and secure design make it suitable for journeys up to several hours. For very long journeys, take breaks to let your pet stretch and drink water.

title: Lionto Foldable Transport Carrier for Small Animals — Rabbits, Guinea Pigs, and Small Pets
description:
## About the Lionto Foldable Small Animal Carrier

The Lionto Foldable Transport Carrier is specifically designed for small animals like rabbits, guinea pigs, ferrets, and small mammals who need a secure, comfortable carrier for vet visits and short journeys. Its lightweight foldable design makes it practical for households with limited storage space.

Small animal owners know that finding a proper [rabbit carrier](/carriers/small-animal-carriers/rabbit-carriers) or [guinea pig carrier](/carriers/small-animal-carriers/guinea-pig-carriers) can be tricky. Most carriers are designed for cats and dogs, leaving rabbit and guinea pig parents making do with unsuitable options. This Lionto carrier solves that problem with a purpose built design for small pet needs.

## Key Features

### Foldable Design

The carrier collapses flat when not in use, making it easy to store in a cupboard or under a bed. Setting it up takes seconds when you need it. This is a huge benefit for owners who only travel occasionally.

### Lightweight and Portable

Weighing less than 1kg empty, it is easy to carry even with a rabbit or guinea pig inside. The sturdy handle sits comfortably in your hand and distributes weight evenly.

### Secure Ventilation

Multiple mesh panels provide excellent airflow while ensuring your small pet cannot escape. Small animals get stressed easily, so proper ventilation and visibility helps keep them calm during travel.

### Zip Closure with Safety Clip

The reinforced zip closure with a security clip prevents accidental openings. Rabbits and ferrets are especially good at working out how to escape from carriers, so this dual security feature is essential.

### Padded Interior Base

The removable padded base provides comfort during travel and can be washed separately. Some owners add a familiar blanket or hay for extra security.

## Perfect For

This [small animal carrier](/carriers/small-animal-carriers) is ideal for:

- Rabbits of small and medium size
- Guinea pigs (single or bonded pairs of small guineas)
- [Ferrets](/carriers/small-animal-carriers/ferret-carriers)
- Hamsters and gerbils (with appropriate padding)
- Small rescue pets during transport
- Trips to the vet, groomer, or short visits to family

## How to Prepare Your Small Animal for Travel

### Before the Journey

Line the carrier with soft bedding and a piece of familiar blanket from home. This provides scent security that helps reduce stress. Add a small handful of hay for rabbits and guinea pigs.

### During Travel

Keep the carrier level and avoid sudden movements. Cover with a light towel if your pet seems very stressed by visual stimulation. Never leave a small animal carrier in direct sunlight or a hot car.

### After the Journey

Let your pet decompress in their normal enclosure for at least an hour before handling. Clean the carrier base after each use to prevent bacteria buildup.

faqs.question: Is this carrier suitable for two guinea pigs?
faqs.answer: For very short journeys, two small guinea pigs can share this carrier. For longer trips or larger guinea pigs, we recommend one carrier per pig to ensure adequate space and reduce stress.

faqs.question: Can I use this for my rabbit?
faqs.answer: Yes, this carrier suits rabbits up to 5kg. Larger rabbits (Flemish Giants, larger Continental rabbits) may need a bigger option. Measure your rabbit and check the internal dimensions before purchase.

faqs.answer: The carrier collapses by removing the padded base, unclipping the internal supports, and flattening the frame. It stores as a flat pack when not in use.

faqs.answer: While not officially vet endorsed, this style of carrier is commonly recommended by rabbit and small animal rescues due to its ventilation, security, and appropriate sizing.

title: Dog Car Carrier LightWeight 68.5x52x52cm, Foldable Dog Carrier, Green
description:
## About This Foldable Dog Car Carrier

This foldable dog car carrier is built around a steel wire frame with a PP honeycomb top board and honeycomb bottom pad, giving it a sturdy structure that resists collapsing while staying light. At around 2.6kg (5.7lbs), it is noticeably lighter than a typical iron frame transport cage of the same size, which makes it easier to carry to and from the car.

It measures approximately 61 x 45 x 52cm internally, giving a small to medium dog room to sit, turn around, and settle in comfortably.

## Key Features

### Indoor and Outdoor Use

Doubles as a cat house or dog crate at home, a secured pet seat in the car, or an outdoor pet tent. The [foldable dog carrier](/carriers/dog-carriers) design means it packs away flat when not needed, rather than taking up permanent space.

### Breathable, Private Design

Three sided roller blinds combine with four sided nylon mesh panelling to give privacy, sunshade, and rain protection while still keeping air moving, so your dog does not feel stuffy or exposed inside.

### Secure Car Fixings

Designed for [car travel](/carriers/car-travel-carriers), with lockable zippers and safety belt fixings that keep your dog secured to the seat rather than sliding around during the journey.

### Easy to Clean

The bottom cushion and foot pads are removable and washable, and the base fabric wipes clean, so everyday mess from muddy paws or travel accidents is straightforward to deal with.

## Specifications

- Internal dimensions: approximately 61cm x 45cm x 52cm
- Weight when empty: approximately 2.6kg (5.7lbs)
- Frame: steel wire with PP honeycomb top board and honeycomb base
- Colour: Green
- Use: indoor crate, car travel carrier, outdoor pet tent
